title: Five Levels Of Pushups
hook: Here are the five levels of pushups and how to figure out which one is right for you.
body:
Start with countertop pushups, then move to knee pushups, regular pushups, decline pushups with your feet on a chair, and finally handstand pushups.

Pushup handles are a variation of regular pushups that extend your range of motion. Do each level until you can do 15 reps, then progress to the next one.
